title: Define package product scope
description: Lock the v1 package promise, naming approach, intended users, non-goals, and initial monetization links so the workspace build stays focused.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Package scope and naming strategy are documented | - [x] v1 promise is written in one sentence | - [x] Non-v1 features are explicitly excluded | - [x] Target users are identified | - [x] Initial support and monetization links are chosen

title: Restructure repo into workspace
description: Convert the current single-app repo into a pnpm workspace with separate package and example folders plus shared root scripts and config.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] pnpm workspace is configured at the repo root | - [x] Shared TypeScript base config exists | - [x] packages/core, packages/react, and examples/vite-demo exist | - [x] Existing app is moved or adapted into the example app | - [x] Root scripts cover build, test, lint, typecheck, and demo dev

title: Extract pure puzzle core
description: Create a framework-agnostic puzzle engine package by moving board logic, types, scrambling, movement, and solved-state checks out of the app UI.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Core domain types are defined | - [x] Solved board generation is implemented | - [x] Legal move detection and immutable move updates are implemented | - [x] Win detection is implemented | - [x] Solvable scramble generation supports intended grid sizes | - [x] Public versus internal APIs are documented

title: Design React package API
description: Create the React-facing API surface for the puzzle package, including hook and component contracts, content input model, callbacks, and customization boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Minimal public API is defined for v1 | - [x] Controlled versus uncontrolled behavior is decided | - [x] useSlidingPuzzle API is specified | - [x] SlidingPuzzle component API is specified | - [x] Content input mode is chosen | - [x] Supported customization props and callbacks are defined

title: Generalize rendering and styling
description: Adapt the tile viewport and board rendering so the package works in arbitrary containers with configurable styling and touch-friendly interactions.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Rendering works outside the full-screen app layout | - [x] Tile slicing remains correct across supported grid sizes | - [x] Styling does not force Tailwind on consumers | - [x] Animation and empty-tile behavior are configurable | - [x] Mobile and touch interactions are validated

title: Build example app
description: Create a demo app that consumes the local workspace packages and showcases the main supported use cases for manual QA and documentation.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Example app consumes workspace packages instead of app-local logic | - [x] Current UI puzzle experience is ported into the demo | - [x] Demo includes UI content, image puzzle, and custom controls examples | - [x] Demo is usable as the main manual QA surface

title: Add automated tests
description: Add a workspace test setup with strong coverage on the core puzzle engine and focused interaction tests for the React package.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Test runner is configured for the workspace | - [x] Core tests cover solved state, legal moves, illegal moves, immutability, win detection, and scramble solvability | - [x] React tests cover rendering, tile movement, and solve callbacks | - [x] Key configurable props have behavioral or layout coverage

title: Harden package build and typing
description: Configure package builds, type declarations, exports maps, peer dependencies, and compatibility choices for publishable npm packages.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Package tsconfig files are in place | - [x] Both packages emit declaration files | - [x] exports maps are correct | - [x] React peer dependencies are configured properly | - [x] Core stays framework-agnostic | - [x] Module format strategy is decided and verified

title: Write package documentation
description: Rewrite documentation around package consumption, examples, customization, limitations, and support links rather than only the current app.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Root README explains the package product clearly | - [x] Package-specific READMEs exist for core and react | - [x] Quickstart and installation are documented | - [x] Public APIs and supported use cases are documented | - [x] Styling and accessibility guidance is included | - [x] Visual examples and support links are added

title: Set up release engineering
description: Prepare licensing, CI, versioning, changelog, npm publishing, and release checklist work needed for a reliable first package release.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] License is chosen and added | - [x] CI covers build, test, and typecheck | - [x] Publish workflow is defined | - [x] Package name availability is checked before release | - [x] Trusted publishing is configured if available | - [x] Versioning and release checklist are documented

title: Prepare support and monetization surfaces
description: Set up lightweight monetization and contact surfaces that support a free npm package while leaving room for future paid offerings.
acceptance_criteria: - [x] Sponsorship or donation channels are created | - [x] Support links appear in docs and demo surfaces | - [x] Custom integration contact path exists | - [x] Future paid layers are named without bloating v1

title: Evaluate post-v1 expansion options
description: Capture optional future work such as image mode, seeded sharing, keyboard accessibility, headless mode, and possible puzzle-family expansion after adoption data exists.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Post-v1 enhancements are documented separately from v1 scope | - [ ] Expansion options are prioritized using user demand | - [ ] Jigsaw or generic puzzle-core work is deferred until sliding-package adoption is validated
